faqs.question: Are Ceylon Explore Tours private or group tours?
faqs.answer: All our itineraries are 100% private tours. You will travel in a dedicated, air-conditioned vehicle with your personal English-speaking chauffeur guide, allowing full flexibility to stop, adjust timing, and explore at your own pace.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation and refund policy?
faqs.answer: We offer free cancellation up to 48 hours prior to the scheduled tour start date for standard day excursions. Multi-day tour packages can be cancelled up to 7 days before arrival for a full refund minus any non-refundable hotel deposit fees.

faqs.question: Are airport pickups and hotel drop-offs included?
faqs.answer: Yes, round-trip transfers from Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB) or your hotel in Colombo, Negombo, or along the itinerary route are included in your private tour package with meet-and-greet service.

faqs.question: Can we customize the tour itineraries?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Every itinerary on our website can be tailored to match your preferences, travel dates, pace, budget, and special interests. Simply contact our travel specialists or submit a custom inquiry.

faqs.question: What type of vehicles are provided?
faqs.answer: We provide modern, fully air-conditioned tourist board approved vehicles: sedans (Toyota Axio/Prius) for 1-2 guests, luxury minivans (Toyota KDH/Commuter) for 3-6 guests, and larger passenger coaches for larger families.

faqs.question: How do customer reviews work on Ceylon Explore Tours?
faqs.answer: We only publish authentic verified reviews from travelers who have booked and completed a tour with us. Following completion of your journey, you will receive an invitation link to submit your honest review and photos.
